item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
Timer Expired. Edits made as discussed below. Author may revert changes at any time.

The WikiWalk team is proposing edits to this page. All proposed edits will be in a collapsible below this post, and after 7 days if there are no serious objections to the edits, the feedback received will be taken into account as the edits are made. If you have questions not directly related to the article about this project, please pm a member of the WikiWalk Team

+ Show Block
- Hide Block

This article stumped me for a while in terms of what to crosslink it to due mainly to the fact that there is not a ton of tales/lore surrounding 718, and there are not a lot of other articles that really match for a crosslink. Then, I came across Roget's Proposal which includes SCP-718 in its documentation, as well as numerous other keter class anomalies. An inline link to that article would be both intrusive to this article, and great for the wikiwalk since the reader's attention there could be drawn towards other keter class anomalies. As such, I am proposing the following edit:

Changing the following:

If SCP-718 is not removed from a living subject, testing indicates that the subject becomes able to 'see' through SCP-718. Vision with SCP-718 is different, as [DATA EXPUNGED] is now visible, at the expense of more conventional sight. This has an extremely detrimental effect on subjects, drastically lowering mental stability and often leading to suicide. The death of a host will cause SCP-718 to burst.

To this:

If SCP-718 is not removed from a living subject, testing indicates that the subject becomes able to 'see' through SCP-718. Vision with SCP-718 is different, as [DATA EXPUNGED] is now visible, at the expense of more conventional sight. This has an extremely detrimental effect on subjects, drastically lowering mental stability and often leading to suicide. The death of a host will cause SCP-718 to burst.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Well congrats, you've got yourself some fuel to expand the entry on.

But remember, these things are self-reproducing. A single enemy escaping, hell, even a single infected BIRD flying away and this will get out of hand. And even if you do keep it contained, what happens when you try and send personell into the base? They can't do anything at best, and at worst they start the process and get themselves infected.

Its 100% infectious, its mind-affecting, it causes death, and doesn't discriminate. Now of course, I can't say anything at all on the research project, what with [DATA EXPUNGED].

However, it may bear research into using this SCP on organic keter level SCPs.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Humm…possible, possible. Assuming that they don’t react odd to fire or explosions, that would work. Now, the question becomes, is it worth keeping these things around in order to research their ability? As nasty as these things are, they do allow vision into an otherwise unreachable form of sight. Find a way to use that, and it could become very useful. They’re also relatively easy to contain, just stick them in a room and don’t let people get stared at for too long. Imagine dropping a bunch of these into an enemy base…

I guess it seems like the army would want it for shock attacks, and the researchers would want it for the vision. If people vote for this to be neutralized, I’ll punch up an entry for that and change the status. I’ll watch the rating and comments, and see what people feel is the best idea.
